'''Arumed''' was a small settlement that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==Description==
Arumed was a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] facility and was administered by the corporation [[AruMed]], from which the settlement got its name. At Arumed, the CSA focused on developing new biotechnologies from Nyriaan's resources. The facility's [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] also administered medical care to people, but were not entirely altruistic in their motives and often carried out tests on their patients, often worsening the condition that the patient was suffering from.
